note: 20 designs clustered from the 30-photo B38 album (reviewed image-by-image, Sep 2026). Prices are editable defaults in paise — the owner adjusts them in Studio → Designs without code.

designs.name: Cocoa Drip Crown
designs.tagline: Dark ganache dripping over whipped chocolate, ringed with two-tone rosettes and gold pearls.
designs.story: The cake that made people ask where B38 trained. Glossy ganache is poured at exactly the right temperature so it falls in slow tears, then the rosette crown is piped one swirl at a time.

designs.name: Blue Hour Milestone
designs.tagline: A hand-painted midnight-blue top, white chocolate sails around the base, pearls scattered like foam.
designs.story: Made for a 30th that deserved a little teasing — the painted top takes any short line you like: an age, an in-joke, a year.

designs.name: Blue Blossom Wreath
designs.tagline: Individual buttercream petals piped into a loose wreath — every flower a separate decision.
designs.story: Vintage-piping at its most patient: cornflower blue, white blossoms and tiny green leaves, finished with pearl dragees.

designs.name: Black Forest, Done Properly
designs.tagline: Chocolate sponge, whipped cream, dark shavings, glazed cherries with stems.
designs.story: No shortcuts: real cherry syrup soaks each layer and the shavings are cut from a slab of dark chocolate, never bought as sprinkles.

designs.name: Powder Blue Rosette
designs.tagline: Sky-blue rosettes dissolving into white, silver pearls, white chocolate flakes at the base.
designs.story: Our most-requested colour. The rosette ring is piped in one continuous session so the pressure — and therefore every petal — stays even.

designs.name: Sapphire Shell Ring
designs.tagline: Deep blue shells piped ring on ring, silver dragees, a clean white canvas for the message.
designs.story: A father's birthday cake in the archive that keeps getting re-ordered in other colours — the piping pattern works with any name on top.

designs.name: Vintage Rose Fringe
designs.tagline: Hand-ruffled pink fringe from collar to board, crowned with buttercream roses and blossoms.
designs.story: Every fringe strand is piped with a basketweave tip, one pass at a time — about ninety minutes of piping before the flowers even start.

designs.name: Lavender Daisy Field
designs.tagline: Soft lavender buttercream with white daisies scattered like a summer meadow.
designs.story: Quietly the site's most photogenic cake — daisies are piped freehand and placed while the buttercream is still tacky so they sit flush.

designs.name: Midnight Oreo & Gold
designs.tagline: Black ganache waterfall over grey-beige frosting, crowned with gold-dusted Oreos and chocolate.
designs.story: The celebration cake for people who find regular cakes too polite. Every piece of the crown is hand-dusted with edible gold.

designs.name: Midnight Truffle & Nuts
designs.tagline: Near-black truffle finish with a roasted-nut border and dark chocolate shards.
designs.story: For serious chocolate people — the glaze is worked in layers until it turns almost black, then edged with caramelised nuts for crunch.

designs.name: Cream & Oreo Name Cake
designs.tagline: Ribbed white chocolate cream, Oreo fan and dark shards, the name and age piped bold.
designs.story: A kids'-birthday workhorse from the archive — the tall single tier photographs beautifully and the name is piped, not printed.

designs.name: Mint Daisy Ribbons
designs.tagline: Ribbons of mint-green piped edge to edge, blush daisies tucked into the texture.
designs.story: The teal version of our daisy style — the ribbon work gives the frosting real depth in person, not just on camera.

designs.name: Blue Rosette Garden
designs.tagline: Rosette roses in two blues with a falling-petal skirt and silver pearls.
designs.story: Roses are piped straight onto the cake — no nail, no transfer — which is why each one keeps its own swirl direction.

designs.name: Pastel Rose Wreath
designs.tagline: Blush and violet roses over a wreath of blossoms, tiny hearts stencilled down the side.
designs.story: The softest cake in the archive — a favourite for engagements and first anniversaries.

designs.name: Blush Ruffle Medallion
designs.tagline: A ruffled blush frame around a hand-written medallion, buttercream roses leaning in from one side.
designs.story: Made originally for Mother's Day — the medallion carries any message: Maa, a name, a thank-you.

designs.name: Rainbow Rosette Crown
designs.tagline: Strawberry, lemon and blueberry rosettes with teal leaves — a ring of colour on cloud-white.
designs.story: Three buttercream batches, one colour each, piped in rotation so the ring stays balanced all the way around.

designs.name: Oreo Overload Drip
designs.tagline: Blush frosting under a dark chocolate drip, buried in Oreos, donuts and chocolate squares.
designs.story: The maximum version of a cookies-and-cream cake — we pile the crown high and let one Oreo tumble down the side on purpose.

designs.name: Orchard Fruit Cream
designs.tagline: Clouds of whipped cream piled with kiwi, pineapple, pomegranate and grapes.
designs.story: The lightest cake we make — fruit is cut the morning of pickup and piled at the last minute so nothing weeps.

designs.name: Lavender Ombre & Pearls
designs.tagline: Five hand-blended purples combed edge to edge, scattered with sugar pearls.
designs.story: The archive's most-repeated commission. Each band is blended into the next by eye — no two ombres come out identical, and that's the point.

designs.name: The Groom Stop
designs.tagline: Ribbed white frosting, an edible-print couple, gold beads and a black satin base.
designs.story: Built for the last night of bachelorhood — the couple print is swapped for your own two people, and the script topper says whatever the party needs it to.
